(II)--one of the five heinous sins--narrated to Indra by बृहस्पति; it is a sin against men, women, animals, and creatures of all sorts. Exceptions are given. Any man of any caste or any animal attacking may be attacked and killed in self-defence; this applies to family members also; wild animals like lions and tigers may be killed by the King for the benefit of Gods and Brahmans, and not for self-enjoyment; भगवती Ma1ya1 created men and Gods and १४ kinds of ani- mals as also sacrifices and ordered the worship of Gods by sacrificing पशु to get oneself blessed with health and wealth; पशुस् may be killed for Gods, पितृस्, and for feeding great and respectable persons; in times of danger no sin in the eating of flesh by Brahmans; animals could be sacrificed in honour of शक्ति. Br.
(III)--gave birth to निकृति (daughter) and अनृत (son) by Adharma. वा. १०. ३९; Vi.
--one of the seven sons of कौशिक. M. २०. 3.
